additional_info.subject: Update
additional_info.body:
Issue because where certain EV's cause status errors in the EVSE-DC meters from LEM during the charging process. As a result, at ERK charging stations, the SiD does not transmit the charged energy amount or the OCMF record to the CPO via OCPP.
R&D ticket addressed to v8.1.X. Fix to be implemented yet.

additional_info.body:
Dear Rene´ Ruppert,
I am reaching out in regards of ticket
ID0417366.
Apologies for the late feedback and reply.
The ticket was opened for 0kW sessions on ERK chargers due to OCMF parameter Invalid. I am pleased to inform you that our R&D department has been working on a fix for this issue, and the solution will be implemented in the Sicharge D FW
release 8.1.X.
Expected date for the release of the FW is CW39 of 2025.
As there are no further pending actions from Service side, I will proceed to close this ticket. If you need further support, please refer to my colleague Semih Sentuerk who follows in copy, as he's supporting the service coordination for RC-DE.
If you need any further assistance, please do reach back out to us by submitting a new request at
www.siemens.com/emobility-service-request
Kindly note that email responses to closed tickets are not monitored.
